planets.name: Kepler-42 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-42 with a 1.87-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-42 d was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-42. Its orbit and size follow Muirhead et al. 2012's fit, the archive's default.
